gameData.backstory: Wiper spent his early days scavenging for scraps in the shadow of The Safety Pin, earning his keep by 'cleaning' up messes for the local flocks. One particularly nasty incident involving a rogue oil spill and a rival gang of goose bandits left him with a thirst for vengeance... and a distinct metallic glint in his eyes.
gameData.name: Wiper
gameData.personality: Grimly pragmatic: Wiper sees the world in shades of rust and leaking oil, trusting only in what he can dismantle and reassemble. Surprisingly loyal: Once he pledges allegiance to a flock, he'll scrub every last drip of DRIP for them, even if it means getting his beak dirty. Intimidating: His robotic enhancements and blood-stained feathers send a clear message: 'Don't mess with Wiper or his flock'.

specialAbility.description: Wiper can temporarily boost his attack power by cannibalizing nearby scrap metal, turning it into razor-sharp projectiles fired from his Beak Breaker hands. This ability grants +30 to attack for one turn, but lowers his agility by 10 for the next turn due to decreased mobility.
specialAbility.name: Scrap Metal Barrage
